scope: Internal supporting check development and scoped review; not external final review or a security exception

failuresAndCorrections.observed: Vite Windows optimizeSafeRealPathSync child-process spawn failed with EPERM
failuresAndCorrections.correction: The same supported build was rerun with allowed process permissions; no compatibility/security code workaround was added

failuresAndCorrections.observed: VM extraction selected an earlier same-named os binding and produced a syntax error
failuresAndCorrections.correction: Locate the os binding immediately preceding the actual bundled getArgumentsForFile implementation

failuresAndCorrections.observed: No optimizer existed because the fixture disabled dependency discovery without an included dependency
failuresAndCorrections.correction: Add one synthetic local package and explicitly optimize it; assert the real optimized-dependency URL branch is active

failuresAndCorrections.observed: Encoded forward slashes remain literal filename characters under decodeURI and Vite returns a safe empty dummy sourcemap with HTTP 200
failuresAndCorrections.correction: Assert ordinary and Windows-backslash traversal return denial; separately assert the encoded-slash response is an empty dummy map with no synthetic outside bytes. Use mpa fixture mode to avoid SPA HTML fallback ambiguity

failuresAndCorrections.observed: Tightened SSE positive-control assertion rejected HTTP 404 because the request lacked EventSource's required Accept header
failuresAndCorrections.correction: Send Accept: text/event-stream and require HTTP 200 plus text/event-stream before checking absence of permissive CORS. Earlier security-sixth.log passed a weaker 404 check and is superseded

failuresAndCorrections.observed: Cannot find module vite/package.json while root clean npm ci was replacing node_modules
failuresAndCorrections.correction: Wait for clean installation to complete; the unchanged security checks then passed in security-final-after-ci.log

failuresAndCorrections.observed: Vite normalized port 0 to its default 5173; concurrent development verification already used that port
failuresAndCorrections.correction: Reserve and release an OS-selected available TCP port, then pass the selected number to Vite with strictPort true. No existing listener was killed
failuresAndCorrections.verification: security-ephemeral-final.log passed all 10 groups after the fix

failuresAndCorrections.observed: sessionData follows the -dev userData path; Electron43 getLastWebPreferences omits preload paths; Windows preload script URLs use backslashes
failuresAndCorrections.correction: Assert actual isolated sessionData; inspect Debugger.scriptParsed for real preload loading; accept Windows separators. Initial harness failures retained outside repository; final all-mode checks pass.

GHSA-rq7h-c2jc-7f22 explicitly excludes Windows; patched resolvedId registration was inspected but no POSIX runtime reproduction was executed
Custom HTML transformation checked every generated module URL remains on the local origin; no malicious website or attacker JavaScript was executed
HTTP CORS and DNS-rebinding controls were checked directly; loopback binding alone was not used as a disposition
The existing schema-install test filter leaves the Supabase boundary unexecuted despite any zero runner-reported skip count
Live providers/Supabase, installed NSIS/migration, Store package installation and WACK remain separate acceptance gates
Normal-startup verification intercepts app.setLoginItemSettings to avoid changing the real Windows Run registry; that integration is explicitly excluded
